quotes.quote: The CVE Services API supports automation tooling for the CVE Program. Credentials are required for most service endpoints.
Reserves CVE IDs for the organization provided in the short_name query parameter (accessible to CNAs and Secretariat)
Creates a CVE Record from CNA Container JSON for the specified ID (accessible to CNAs and Secretariat)
Updates the CVE Record from CNA Container JSON for the specified ID (accessible to CNAs and Secretariat)
Creates a rejected CVE Record for the specified ID if no record yet exists (accessible to CNAs and Secretariat)
Updates the CVE Record from ADP Container JSON for the specified ID (accessible to ADPs and Secretariat)
Creates a conversation for a specific target UUID (accessible to Secretariat or target organization Admin)
The shortname for the organization associated with the user requesting authentication
